name: exec
arguments:
const p="C:/Users/Jack/Documents/GitHub/PEPFlow/examples_peppy/_evaluations/20260923T140754Z_paper5_pgm_sos_6x5_isolation1/supplementary/evaluation/bppm_r02/validation/symbolic_audit.py";
const src = `"""Independent verification of only the submitted BPPM identities; no proof repair."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sympy as s
j,N,a,R=s.symbols("j N alpha R")
x,y,z,o=s.symbols("x y z o")
fx,fy,fz=s.symbols("fx fy fz")
hx,hy,hz,ho=s.symbols("hx hy hz ho")
gx,gy,go,gf=s.symbols("gx gy go gf")
# x is previous, y is next, z is optimum, o is initial.
def D(hu,hv,gv,u,v): return hu-hv-gv*(u-v)
D0=D(hz,ho,go,z,o)
Dx=D(hz,hx,gx,z,x)
Dy=D(hz,hy,gy,z,y)
Vprev=(j-1)*(fx-fz)/N+(Dx-D0)/(a*N)
Vnext=j*(fy-fz)/N+(Dy-D0)/(a*N)
Cfstar=fy-fz+gf*(z-y)
Cfprev=fy-fx+gf*(x-y)
Chback=hx-hy+gx*(y-x)
Chforward=hy-hx+gy*(x-y)
rhs=Cfstar/N+(j-1)*Cfprev/N+j*Chback/(a*N)+(j-1)*Chforward/(a*N)
step=s.factor((Vnext-Vprev-rhs).subs(gy,gx-a*gf))
four=((go-gy)*(z-y)+(y-o)*go+ho-hy)/(a*N)+j*(fy-fz)/N
boundary=s.factor((fy-fz-R/(a*N))-(Vnext.subs(j,N)+(D0-R)/(a*N)-Dy/(a*N)))
results={"step":str(step),"four_vector":str(s.factor(four-Vnext)),"boundary":str(boundary),"base":str(s.factor(Vprev.subs({j:1,x:o,hx:ho,gx:go})))}
assert all(v=="0" for v in results.values())
results["scope"]="Fresh exact expansion of submitted bilinear identities, with arbitrary symbolic j,N,alpha,R. Scalar-coordinate representation suffices since every inner-product term is bilinear and the cancellation is coordinatewise; no dimension-dependent identity is used. Sign/domain implications inspected in notebook."
Path("symbolic-audit.json").write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2),encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps(results))
`;
text(await tools.apply_patch("*** Begin Patch\n*** Add File: "+p+"\n"+src.split("\n").map(x=>"+"+x).join("\n")+"\n*** End Patch"));
